sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer policy schedule)

room_rent.display: Any room (no cap); Twin Sharing 20% copay only
room_rent.note: Elite: All Room Categories except Deluxe and Suite = 0%; All Room Categories (incl. Deluxe/Suite) = 0%; General Ward = 0%; Twin Sharing Room = 20% copay. Effectively any room including Deluxe/Suite at 0% copay; only Twin Sharing triggers 20% copay (downgrade penalty).

icu.note: No specific ICU sub-limit for Elite; covered up to Sum Insured.

copayment.display: None (any room including Deluxe/Suite); Twin Sharing 20%
copayment.note: No mandatory copay for Elite on any room category except Twin Sharing (20%). HeadsUp/Tiered Network non-compliance triggers 20% copay.

sub_limits.display: No sub-limits (including modern treatments up to SI)
sub_limits.note: Elite variant does not restrict cataract to Mono-focal lens (no such note for Elite). Modern treatments covered up to Sum Insured for Elite (Modern Treatments+ add-on not needed/not available for Elite per section 4.54).

initial_waiting.note: Can be reduced via optional Initial Wait Period Modification add-on.

ped_waiting.note: Can be reduced or increased via optional Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Time Modification.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Same list as other variants. Can be modified via optional Specific Disease Waiting Time Modification.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). No inbuilt or optional maternity benefit described for Elite variant.

cumulative_bonus.note: Explicitly cited in wording: Elite variant example shows 10x accumulation (10L base → 1.10Cr after 10 claim-free years).

restoration.note: Same as other variants. ReAssure Forever triggers after first paid claim, unlimited resets up to Base SI per claim.

ambulance.display: Road: up to policy limit; Air: emergency only
ambulance.note: Air Ambulance+ add-on not available for Elite (section 4.55 states only for Classic & Select).

modern_treatments.note: Elite covers modern treatments up to Sum Insured. Modern Treatments+ add-on is only for Classic & Select.

notable_exclusions: Dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, infertility/ART, refractive error <7.5D, conflict/war/terrorism, brain death life support, off-label drug use
optional_riders: Claim Safeguard+, Borderless, Borderless for Specific Illness, International Cover, Personal Accident (Lite/PA/Pro), Hospital Daily Cash, WellConsult+, NivaBupaOne, Cash-Bag+, Critical Illness, HeadsUp, Tiered Network, ElderOne
